design.target: Explain client-visible axis differences. Forward speedup is not the target label.
design.cost_scope: Empirical fixed-action host costs from discovery/calibration only. Keep Original model, B/S, exact rows and actual Batch fixed.

candidates.name: ISOLATED_D_COST_RATIO
candidates.definition: Calibrated D service ratio only. This is action metadata, not a measured online queue state.
candidates.failure_test: It must explain why a lower D Forward cost can still produce higher online TTFT.

candidates.name: EFFECTIVE_PIPELINE_CYCLE_RATIO
candidates.definition: max(P_L,D_L/b) / max(P_T,D_T/b), including calibrated host gaps.
candidates.failure_test: Low load may follow P+D rather than the saturated cycle. It cannot prove sustainable capacity.

candidates.name: SINGLE_PRESSURE_RATIO
candidates.known_information: Pending request IDs and actual completed-token counts exist before P submission. Active remaining time uses calibrated costs. No future completion is read.

candidates.name: TWO_QUEUE_WORK_CLOCKS
candidates.definition: Q_P is calibrated work for already-arrived pending P requests. Q_D is active residual plus already-ready D cohort work.
candidates.rule: Compare action-dependent predicted first-token completion and queue-work penalty. Start with the single-ratio rule. Add a second independent clock only if discovery shows a necessary counterexample.

design.calibration_split: Use new q0.5 calibration and mechanism/residency discovery. Historical discovery is a separately labeled fallback, not new GPU evidence.
design.evaluation_split: Freeze chosen rule and costs before reading heldout_confirmation metrics. Evaluate new arrival seeds, QPS and batch separately. Reused prompts are not an unseen prompt distribution.
design.winner_labels: Require paired independent-start95% CI to exclude1. Uncertain cells stay UNRESOLVED. Also report continuous TTFT/goodput regret.
design.replay_action_boundary: 18-request blocks, divisible by9 and Decode2. This preserves exact aggregate Token/Layer work within every selected block.
design.oracle_scope: Search Layer/Token at the same cut first. Compare the best fixed axis across all cuts separately. A restricted action grid is not a global systems upper bound.
design.replay_scope: Update FIFO P queue, D whole-cohort guard, source outstanding window and fixed-request KV reservations. Validate fixed traces before counterfactual claims.
design.model_gate: The frozen replay gate requires TTFTp95 error<=10%, Token/s error<=5%, Ready-D mean error<=max(10ms,20%).
design.stop_rule: If model validation fails or oracle headroom is below5% or uncertain, do not implement an online dynamic scheduler.
